title: Dynamic kernel profiling and decision logic for arch+seq-len aware selection
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Problem: Kernel performance for attention and matmul kernels varies significantly across model architecture (transformer block size, head count), sequence length, and GPU microarchitecture. Current static rules pick kernels by model family only and cause suboptimal throughput or latency spikes for out-of-distribution seq-len workloads and newer GPUs.

Goal: Implement a lightweight dynamic profiling + cost model that chooses the optimal kernel variant at runtime per (GPU_arch, seq_len_bucket, dtype, effective_batch) and maintains safety fallbacks. The design should be low-overhead in steady-state, support canary rollout, and integrate with runtime metrics for continuous re-tuning.

Scope: proof-of-concept profiling agent inside the serving process, a compact on-device cost table, decision API used by prefill & decode schedulers, fallback logic, and a metrics+dashboard to track selection correctness and regressions. Do NOT change model weights or quantization in this ticket; focus on kernel selection heuristics and autotuning runtime only.

Success metrics: +10% median throughput for mixed seqlen workloads on T4/A100, no >5% latency regression for <64 token requests, canary rollout with automatic rollback on perf regression.

Artifacts: design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RUN/Dynamic+Kernel+Profiling, profiling prototype branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4523, benchmark dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/runtime/kernel-autotune
comments: 2026-02-27 - Ava Martinez: Created ticket after perf review meeting. Initial spike showed divergent fast-paths between fused-attn and block-gemm on A100 for seqlen=1024. Requested prototype that samples kernel latency across top 3 kernel variants per op.

2026-03-02 - Liam Chen: Spike complete. Implemented micro-benchmark harness that runs 50 warm iterations then 200 samples to estimate p50/p95 per kernel variant. Observations: fused-attn best for seqlen >= 768 on A100 (fp16), block-gemm wins for seqlen <= 256. On T4, memory-bound kernels are worse beyond batch>4. Draft PR created (4523).

2026-03-04 - Priya Singh (Perf Eng): Reviewed spike results. Concern: 200-sample profile is too slow for cold-start models with low QPS. Suggested adaptive sampling: cap profiling to N=40 if request latency budget low, and persist profile per model+variant in local cache for 24h.

2026-03-06 - Liam Chen: Implemented adaptive sampler: samples until confidence interval on median < 8% or max_samples=60. Stores aggregate histograms keyed by (model_hash, gpu_arch, dtype). Added size-bucketed seq_len keys (<=64, 65-256, 257-768, >768). Added feature flag runtime.kernel_autotune=true for canary.
2026-03-08 - Design review: Agrees with bucketization but requested adding a special 'long-tail' probe for very long sequences (>2048) to avoid misclassifying rare but expensive requests.

2026-03-10 - Benchmarks: Canary on staging with 100k requests mixed seqlen distribution: overall throughput +14% on A100 for mixed workload, but observed ~6.2% p95 latency regression for <64 token requests under low batch due to profiler overhead in first 3 minutes. Action: move profiling to background worker and enforce max concurrent probes per worker=2.

2026-03-11 - SRE (Jordan Blake): Alerting rules added: if selection-based throughput drops by >7% vs baseline for 5m, auto-disable autotune for that model. Also added circuit-breaker to revert to model-default kernel if more than 2 selection errors in 5 minutes.

2026-03-12 - Liam Chen: Implemented background probe worker and rate limiter; re-ran staging canary. p95 regression reduced to 1.1% and throughput retained +12%. Posted updated PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4551 for review. Next: broader canary in dedicated pool and dashboard alerts for selection oscillation.

2026-03-12 - PM (Sofia Alvarez): Requested doc for rollout plan and user-visible change log. Also asked to expose a config knob per tenant to disable autotune (enterprise customers with strict determinism).
